about: Degraded engine answers for the drill in tools/engine-degraded-test.cjs. Each row is what a provider hands back (a raw answer, or {"$throw": kind}) and the fallback the desk owes the learner at the TV. Rows with a todo name a gap the desk has today: the fix sits on the live model surface (desk/src/lib/desk/hint.ts, read.ts), so it waits for a live drift record (.ai/memory/0017). JSON cannot carry NaN, and real providers answer in JSON text, so a NaN coordinate is not a case here.
